card.name: Start of "inconclusive" and "concomitant"
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word, "incon" in "inconclusive" or "con" in "concomitant", in drug-label text. It is strongest on "incon" after "are" or "is" when data or evidence are described as unclear.

modes.label: inconclusive data
modes.description: "incon" begins "inconclusive" after "are" or "is", describing weak study evidence.
modes.example: Data from observational studies regarding other potential embryofetal risks of NSAID use in women in the first or second trimesters of pregnancy are<< incon>>clusive.

modes.label: concomitant use
modes.description: "con" begins "concomitant" before use or drug names.
modes.example: Most reports have been associated with<< con>>comitant use of serotonergic drugs

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing the word with the following letters, not toward any clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of the words "inconclusive" and "concomitant" in drug labels.
